index.title: An ecosystem of leaders
index.summary: Entrepreneurs, founders and business leaders across North Bengal's key sectors — the people who make up the TiE Siliguri community.
intro: TiE Siliguri brings together two kinds of members: Charter Members — established entrepreneurs who guide the chapter — and Associate Members — aspiring founders and professionals building their ventures.
Together they span healthcare, education, finance, manufacturing, technology, hospitality, real estate and more.

cards.title: Charter Members
cards.body: The established entrepreneurs and business leaders who guide TiE Siliguri.

cards.title: Associate Members
cards.body: Aspiring founders and professionals growing within the TiE community.

associateMembers.title: The next generation of founders
associateMembers.summary: Aspiring entrepreneurs and professionals who benefit from learning, mentorship and networking within the TiE Siliguri community — and who bring its energy.
intro: Associate Members are the growing heart of the chapter: startup founders, professionals and aspiring entrepreneurs who engage in every session, mixer and mentoring clinic.
While Charter Members guide the chapter, Associate Members drive its momentum — learning from experienced mentors and building the ventures that will shape North Bengal's economy.

items: Promising entrepreneurs invited by Charter Members or recommended by seasoned Associate Members.
A growth-oriented vision — scalable startups and SMEs across sectors like e-commerce, hospitality, logistics, manufacturing and IT.
A demonstrated commitment to integrity and ethical business practices.
A genuine, long-term interest in personal and business growth within the ecosystem.
Willingness to contribute actively to events, mentorship programs and investor relations.
